name: Oza Cesuras (Spain)
description: White banner charged with the red interlaced knot of the municipal emblem above the name OZA-CESURAS in red letters.
history: Municipal flag of Oza Cesuras; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: interlaced knot of four loops with the name OZA-CESURAS beneath
